A '''droid teacher''' of a [[Unidentified service droid model (At Attin)|service droid]] model taught at [[At Attin Middle School Gamma]] on the [[planet]] [[At Attin]].<ref name="Real Adventure" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> The [[droid]]'s class was visited by [[Undersecretary]] [[Fara]] the [[Local day|day]] before the students were due to take their [[Career Assessment Test]].<ref name="Real Adventure" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The droid teacher first appeared in "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]"<ref name="Real Adventure" /> the first episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref> The teacher was voiced by [[Helen Sadler]].<ref name="Teacher droid">{{Instagram|username=shelbyhyoung|name=[[Shelby Young]]|date=2024-12-03|quote=you can hear me as lil cutie roona in the first episode of skeleton crew (+ @iamhelensadler is perfect as the teacher droid!)|archivefile=File:ShelbyYoung-TeacherDroid-IG.png|nolive=1}}</ref>
